mapper.select: SELECT B.USER_ID AS USER_ID , B.USER_PASSWORD , B.USER_ROLE , B.USER_WITHDRAW_DATE , B.USER_STATUS , B.USER_ENABLED , A.MEM_NAME , A.MEM_EMAIL , A.MEM_BIR , A.MEM_TEL , A.MEM_ADD1 , A.MEM_ADD2 , A.MEM_IMG FROM MEMBER A JOIN USERS B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID WHERE B.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT B.USER_ID AS USER_ID , B.USER_PASSWORD , B.USER_ROLE , B.USER_WITHDRAW_DATE , B.USER_STATUS , B.USER_ENABLED , A.MEM_NAME , A.MEM_EMAIL , A.MEM_BIR , A.MEM_TEL , A.MEM_ADD1 , A.MEM_ADD2 , A.MEM_IMG FROM MEMBER A JOIN USERS B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID
